# OpenZeppelin Contracts for Canton

> Reusable, security-focused Daml packages for applications on the Canton Network.

These links describe the development branch (`main`). The packages have no tagged release yet.
Build a package from a pinned source commit, as the `README.md` "Consume a local build" section
shows, and read the documentation at that commit: replace `main` in a URL with the commit. For
audits, always use the current index below. Reports are published after the code they cover, and
each one names the commit and scope it covers.

## Start here

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/canton-contracts/main/README.md):
  overview, requirements, building and consuming a package
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/canton-contracts/main/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  design decisions and constraints
- [GUIDELINES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/canton-contracts/main/GUIDELINES.md):
  coding conventions for contributors

## Packages

- [Packages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/canton-contracts/main/packages/README.md):
  every library package, grouped by category

## Examples and API reference

- [Integration examples](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/canton-contracts/tree/main/examples):
  consumer projects that build against the library DARs, each with a sibling `-test` package
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/canton-contracts/main/CONTRIBUTING.md):
  the reference is not published. The "API documentation" section gives the `dpm damlc docs`
  command that renders it from the doc comments of a package.

## Audits

- [audits/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/canton-contracts/main/audits/README.md):
  audit status and, when available, reports with the code and scope each report covers
